title: A Note About Tomorrow
label: ch:zh-a-note-about-tomorrow
canDo: I can understand a notice and a message, and write a connected reply.

payoff.summary: Complete ZH-R157-review-final-157: one dialogue across the A2 core, after reading a notice at work and a friend's message and writing a connected reply of four to six lines.
payoff.note: ZH-W157-reply proves the connected-composition stage: four to six lines that lean on each other, for a named reader (the friend who sent the message) and a real purpose (settling the appointment). Pinyin inside the reply is licensed for words whose characters the book has not taught.
